subject: Upcoming Family Reunion Details
body: Dear Family Members, We are excited to share the details for our upcoming family reunion! The event will be held on Saturday, August 21st at the local park from 11 AM to 4 PM. There will be games, food, and plenty of opportunities to catch up with relatives. Please RSVP by August 10th so we can finalize the arrangements. We look forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, The Johnson Family
